hook: Give your Mac app a truly custom About window

beats.say: Every macOS app gets a default About panel showing the icon, name, version and build number. Nil Coalescing shows how to replace it entirely.
Since macOS 13, the Window scene and the openWindow environment value let you build a fully custom About window with standard SwiftUI APIs.
You override the app info command placement with a new command group, so the About item in the app menu opens your own window with the version, copyright and a developer website link.
